basic_info.description: Located in the vibrant heart of the Valencia corridor, this spacious top floor Loft effortlessly combines two levels of modern design with functional living. The main floor is perfect for entertaining, featuring an open floor plan w/ soaring ceilings & skylights. The LR, complete w/ a gas fireplace, flows seamlessly into the dining & kitchen areas. A full bath & a large storage space complete this level.  Upstairs, the spacious primary suite boasts city & Twin Peaks views with 2 large closets & an en-suite bath w/ a skylight. Adjacent is a versatile loft area that can serve as an office, guest bedroom or media space, as well as a laundry closet with stackable w/d.  The residence showcases glazed concrete floors w/ radiant heat on the lower level & hardwood floors upstairs. Floor-to-ceiling UV-coated windows w/ remote-controlled solar shades enhance the space, along w/ deeded parking incl. a Tesla EV charger, & addt'l storage. With easy access to public transportation, the 101/80 freeways, & a variety of neighborhood highlights including restaurants, cafes, shopping, nightlife, & parks, this home offers the ultimate urban lifestyle.
